variables.input:
fetch logs, from:$dt_timeframe_from
| filter dt.system.bucket == "audit_logs"
| filter log.source != "alstom/audit/users"
| filter eventType == "LOGIN"
| dedup user
| fields user

fetch logs
| filter dt.system.bucket == "audit_logs"
| filter log.source != "alstom/audit/users"
| filter eventType == "LOGIN"
| lookup [fetch logs
| filter dt.system.bucket == "audit_logs"
| filter log.source == "alstom/audit/users"
], sourcefield: user, lookupfield:email
| expand lookup.groups
| summarize count(), by:{lookup.groups}
| filter lookup.groups != "Default group with all users"
| fields lookup.groups

0.title: Current Active Users
0.description: This uses a sliding window. If users logged in before the window and didn't log out yet, widen 'from' (e.g., now-24h) to avoid undercount.

1.title: Current Active Users
1.description: Real-time count of users currently logged in.

4.title: Top Users by Activities

6.title: Configuration Changes by Schema
6.query:
fetch logs, from:$dt_timeframe_from
| filter dt.system.bucket == "audit_logs"
| filter log.source != "alstom/audit/users"
| filter isNotNull(dt.settings.schema_id)
| summarize count = count(), by:{dt.settings.schema_id, user}
6.description: Visual summary of configuration changes grouped by schema.

7.title: Configuration Changes by User
7.query:
fetch logs, from:$dt_timeframe_from
| filter dt.system.bucket == "audit_logs"
| filter log.source != "alstom/audit/users"
| filter isNotNull(dt.settings.schema_id)
| summarize count = count(), by:{user}
7.description: Highlights which users are making configuration changes.

8.title: Logins Over the Time
8.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.system.bucket == "audit_logs"
| filter log.source != "alstom/audit/users"
| filter eventType == "LOGIN"
| makeTimeseries Login = count(), interval:1h

dt.statistics.ui.ForecastAnalyzer.query:
fetch logs, from:"2025-09-22T18:30:00.000Z"
| filter dt.system.bucket == "audit_logs"
| filter log.source != "/api/v2/logs/ingest"
// | filter event.type == "LOGIN"
| filter eventType == "LOGIN"
| makeTimeseries count(), interval:1h

8.description: Visualizes login activity trends over time to identify peak usage periods.

9.title: Logins Over the Time by Users
9.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.system.bucket == "audit_logs"
| filter log.source != "alstom/audit/users"
| filter eventType == "LOGIN"
| summarize count = count(), by:{user}
| filter in (user, $Users)

dt.statistics.ui.ForecastAnalyzer.query:
fetch logs, from:"2025-09-22T18:30:00.000Z"
| filter dt.system.bucket == "audit_logs"
| filter log.source != "/api/v2/logs/ingest"
// | filter event.type == "LOGIN"
| filter eventType == "LOGIN"
| makeTimeseries count(), interval:1h

9.description: Breaks down login counts by individual users to highlight usage patterns.

10.title: Logins split by Application Groups
10.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.system.bucket == "audit_logs"
| filter log.source != "alstom/audit/users"
| filter eventType == "LOGIN"
| lookup [fetch logs
| filter dt.system.bucket == "audit_logs"
| filter log.source == "alstom/audit/users"
], sourcefield: user, lookupfield:email
| expand lookup.groups
| summarize count(), by:{lookup.groups}
| filter lookup.groups != "Default group with all users"
| filter in(lookup.groups, $UserGroups)
10.description: Shows login distribution across different application groups.

11.title: Total Users in Environment
11.query:

| filter dt.system.bucket == "audit_logs"
| filter log.source == "alstom/audit/users"
| dedup email

13.title: Total Pending Users in Environment

30.title: Users who Logged In
30.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.system.bucket == "audit_logs"
| filter log.source != "alstom/audit/users"
| filter eventType == "LOGIN"
| fields user
| dedup user
30.description:
Note on Login vs Logout Counts:
The number of logout events exceeds login events because the system may log multiple logout actions per session or user. This can happen due to:

- Session timeouts or automatic logouts triggered by inactivity.
- Manual logouts across different devices or browser tabs.
- System-level logouts during maintenance or updates.
- Duplicate logout entries caused by retries or network issues.

31.title: Users Performing Logout
31.description: If you don't see any user email that means users have not clicked on Sign Out button from the UI. All Logouts are done automatically by system due to session management
31.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.system.bucket == "audit_logs"
| filter log.source != "alstom/audit/users"
| filter eventType == "LOGOUT"
| fields user
| dedup user
